summary: All five candidate artifacts and all five Codex independent-review files match the full digests recorded by D-095. Each Codex review is ACCEPT with zero blockers; every candidate remains CANDIDATE-NOT-RECORDED, binds NOTHING, recommends DO-NOT-SEAL, refuses SATISFIED and file-08 edits, and names a later owning role. The live COORD, file 08, freeze, D-093, and D-094 CONTESTED commit also match, and D-095 correctly leaves G03/G04 reserved, condition 4 at 16 of 18 PARTLY MET, and implementation unauthorized. The recording draft nevertheless assigns the future condition-2 owner path to D-054/D-057, whose adopted scope is condition-1 V1 Route-B owner recording and whose mandatory preconditions cannot be met by these V2 deferrals. objections.title: D-054 and D-057 do not authorize owner-recording these condition-2 deferrals
objections.finding: D-095 says `Named owners still record (D-054 / D-057)` and treats that pair as the future owner-recording path. Adopted D-054 is expressly scoped to `condition 1 owner-recording for preview Route B only`: it permits the assistant to stand in for named V1 owners recording accepted preview Route-B dispositions. Adopted D-057 is mechanics for that same grant. It requires a live row-specific Route-B selection, identifies its eligible V1 rows, and explicitly excludes Route-C use. D-095 instead covers V2 condition-2 rows DR-106/108/109/110/113/116 plus a Windows platform-set disposition. None is a D-057 eligible V1 row with the required row-specific Route-B selection, and DR-116 is expressly a product Route-C decision. The coordinator does not act as owner in this entry, but the cited authority cannot support the later owner acts the entry schedules.
objections.evidence: COORD D-054 subject: `condition 1 owner-recording for preview Route B only`. D-057 turn-3 Decision clauses 2-3 require a row-specific Route-B selection and its commit; clause 5 lists DR-002/003/004/005/008 plus conditional DR-006/007/009 and says DR-010 Route C is not this file. The five candidates name Security, platform, release, evidence, storage, product, and architecture roles for condition-2 deferrals, not those eligible V1 Route-B owner acts. D-000 grants coordinator/product-authority decisions but does not silently make the coordinator every security/release/evidence/platform owner; D-054's reviewed grant was deliberately narrower.
objections.impact: A later assistant-authored owner recording that cites D-054/D-057 for any of these candidates cannot satisfy D-057's own preconditions and would exceed the recorded user amendment. Condition 2 therefore has no lawful owner-recording path as currently stated, even though this coordinator candidate recording itself has zero readiness effect.
objections.requiredRepair: Keep this act strictly as the prior coordinator recording, remove the claim that D-054/D-057 supplies the later owners, and state that owner-recording is blocked until an applicable authority and mechanics are adopted. Alternatively, obtain and record a separate user amendment plus reviewed mechanics expressly covering these named condition-2 security/platform/release/evidence/storage/product/architecture roles and the Windows platform disposition. Later owner entries must pin that applicable grant and treat DR-116 through its preference-laden Route-C authority rather than D-057's Route-B machinery. Refreeze after repair.

objections.title: The draft collapses owner-recording and the later MF-6 despite saying they are separate
objections.finding: Decision item 5 correctly says `Owner-recording plus a later MF-6`, but Alternatives says `owner-recording is the MF-6 act`, and Readiness compresses the sequence into `owner-recorded MF-6`. D-057 says a later MF-6 cell note is a separate act and that dependent MF-6 notes are reconciled under their own reviewed acts. The false Alternatives sentence contradicts the operative decision and can be read as permission to bundle owner recording with a file-08 edit.
objections.evidence: D-057 turn-3 Decision clause 6: `A later MF-6 cell note is a separate act.` Its Reversibility section requires reconciliation of each dependent MF-6 note `under its own reviewed act`. Existing adopted owner records such as D-058 explicitly do not edit file 08 and refer to reconciliation of any later MF-6 note.
objections.impact: The current entry itself still refuses a file-08 edit, so no immediate unauthorized mutation occurs. The contradictory pathway weakens the audit trail and risks same-act bundling in the dependent work.
objections.requiredRepair: Replace the Alternatives sentence with `owner-recording precedes a separate later D-000-reviewed MF-6; neither occurs in this entry`. Rewrite Readiness to say condition 2 remains unchanged until an applicable owner recording lands and a separate later MF-6 records the disposition in file 08.
